title: Amelia Island Charter Fishing LLC.
gap: Price for all day trip not stated
blurb: Guests fish for species including Redfish, Trout, Flounder, Tarpon, Cobia, Black Drum, Jacks, Sharks, and Sheepshead. Trips range from 1.5 to 6 hours including fishing, sightseeing, and sunset cruises. The boat is a custom 28 ft. Panga Center Console operating in shallow to offshore waters.
